English: Earthen Pit
A simple pit dug in the earth, covered with reeds and hides. Used for the most basic storage of grain and supplies, vulnerable to the elements and pests.
Woven Basket
Tough baskets woven from reeds and grass allow nomads to store and transport grain more easily, slightly improving supply and population growth.
Mudbrick Hut
Small huts of sun-dried bricks allow more secure storage, increasing the capacity for food and supplies, and boosting clan sentiment due to improved living conditions.
Raised Silo
Wooden silos raised on stilts help protect valuable grain stores from moisture and vermin, allowing for even greater population and manpower, and improving supply lines.
Guarded Storehouse
A fortified storehouse guarded by trusted warriors. Supplies are carefully watched, improving security, manpower, and storage, and making the clan better prepared for hardship.
Rodent-Proof Hut
Advanced mud and stone huts with sealed floors and walls. Grain stores are protected from pests, reducing waste, and increasing overall population and manpower cap.
Expanded Store
A sprawling complex of interconnected silos, huts, and covered storage, allowing the clan to flourish, store massive reserves, and project strength through sheer numbers.
Market Pavilion
A great tented pavilion where traders gather to exchange goods, grain, and livestock. The clan prospers from increased commerce, population, and improved sentiment.
Grain Exchange Hall
A permanent hall of trade where grain is measured, exchanged, and stored for the benefit of the entire clan. This boosts population, manpower, supply, and unity.
Indian Granary

Inspired by the great granaries of the Indian subcontinent, this monumental structure ensures the clans prosperity through unrivaled storage, logistics, and unity. It is a symbol of civilization and plenty.
